title: NAILS recover --json
description: Machine-readable recover envelope (contract version 2): one document with schema_version, command, ok, and either data (what an interrupted activation left and what was removed; a mount left below /run/nextroot is exit 7) or error: `invalid_state` (exit 6) in the hidden session, with the next step `deactivate`, or while an activation is entering, with no next step (wait for its soft-reboot); `recover_failed` (exit 1) when the recovery itself failed. The envelope frame, the data and the error body are strict. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. A recovery runs to the end once it has begun; a signal does not stop it. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.

outcome.description: `clean` when an interrupted activation left nothing, `rolled_back` when its leftovers were removed.

remaining_mounts.description: Mounts still below /run/nextroot, which a reboot clears (exit 7 when any is left).

backend.description: The hidden backend's device-mapper devices that were still open: `closed` now, or `in_use` and left open, with its key in RAM.
